tasks.title: Conversation #120
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you going to the exercise class on Wednesday evening?
Woman: Yes, I am. I've been looking for a way to relax and de-stress after work.
Man: That's great. I've heard the instructor is excellent and the class is very comic.
Woman: I'm looking forward to it. What time does it start?
Man: It starts at 6 p. m. I'll see you there.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: Are you going to the exercise class on Wednesday evening? 选项分析： A. A dance performance 舞蹈表演。对话中未提及表演，所以A选项错误。 B. An exercise class 健身课。男士明确提到“exercise class”，所以B选项正确。 C. A cooking class 烹饪课。对话中未提及烹饪，所以C选项错误。 D. A book club meeting 读书俱乐部聚会。对话中未提及书籍，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the woman say she wants to attend the event?

options.A: She wants to meet new people.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：女士为什么说她想去参加这个活动？ 定位原文：Woman: I‘ve been looking for a way to relax and de-stress after work. 选项分析： A. She wants to meet new people. 她想认识新朋友。对话中未提及社交目的，所以A选项错误。 B. She knows the instructor. 她认识教练。对话中未提及她是否认识教练，所以B选项错误。 C. She wants to relax. 她想放松。女士明确说想找一种下班后放松和减压的方式，所以C选项正确。 D. She hopes to gain confidence. 她希望能获得自信。对话中未提及自信心，所以D选项错误。
